queries.01-repository-summary:
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX sh: <http://www.w3.org/ns/shacl#>
PREFIX prov: <http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#>
PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
PREFIX mnp: <https://yangjunjie-lin.github.io/KG-MNP-Demo/ontology/terms#>
SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?g) AS ?namedGraphCount) (COUNT(*) AS ?quadCount) (COUNT(DISTINCT ?s) AS ?subjectCount) (COUNT(DISTINCT ?p) AS ?predicateCount) (COUNT(DISTINCT ?o) AS ?objectCount) WHERE { GRAPH ?g { ?s ?p ?o } }
queries.02-named-graph-counts:
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX sh: <http://www.w3.org/ns/shacl#>
PREFIX prov: <http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#>
PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
PREFIX mnp: <https://yangjunjie-lin.github.io/KG-MNP-Demo/ontology/terms#>
SELECT ?g (COUNT(*) AS ?count) WHERE { GRAPH ?g { ?s ?p ?o } } GROUP BY ?g ORDER BY ?g

PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>

SELECT ?s ?p ?o WHERE { GRAPH <urn:kg-mnp:graph:abox:c1ed33ee77a14beb4cdabe3fe5ffe107a58fbb351c65c98d93fbc6dd5a02b881> { ?s ?p ?o . FILTER(?p IN (<http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#domain>, <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#range>, <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#subClassOf>, <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#subPropertyOf>, <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#disjointWith>, <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#equivalentClass>, <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#equivalentProperty>) || (?p = <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#type> && ?o IN (<http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#Class>, <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#DatatypeProperty>, <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#ObjectProperty>, <http://www.w3.org/ns/shacl#NodeShape>, <http://www.w3.org/ns/shacl#PropertyShape>))) } } ORDER BY ?s ?p ?o

PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>

FILTER(!(?p = rdf:type && ?o = owl:Ontology) && ?p != owl:imports) FILTER NOT EXISTS { GRAPH <urn:kg-mnp:graph:modeling-provenance:c1ed33ee77a14beb4cdabe3fe5ffe107a58fbb351c65c98d93fbc6dd5a02b881> { ?assertion a owl:Axiom ; owl:annotatedSource ?s ; owl:annotatedProperty ?p ; owl:annotatedTarget ?o ; mnp:hasReviewDecision ?decision } } } } ORDER BY ?s ?p ?o

FILTER(?extraSession != <urn:kg-mnp:review-session:e6655326071aae1cab2fe855f3ec2310b80605413cb4f5095d13576570c16ae7>) } } FILTER NOT EXISTS { GRAPH <urn:kg-mnp:graph:review-audit:c1ed33ee77a14beb4cdabe3fe5ffe107a58fbb351c65c98d93fbc6dd5a02b881> { ?extraReviewer a prov:Agent . queries.06-tbox-version:

queries.10-no-blank-nodes:
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>

PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
PREFIX mnp: <https://yangjunjie-lin.github.io/KG-MNP-Demo/ontology/terms#>
